verdict.rationale: Adyen documents an official MCP server that lets users work in natural language through their chosen LLM client (docs-20, docs-13, probe-4). It is aimed at developers connecting to the Adyen platform, and nothing shows it covers in-person payment operations such as terminal payments or refunds. It also requires an external LLM client rather than offering a built-in natural-language interface. missing for 10: evidence that the MCP tools cover Terminal API or in-person operations, a native natural-language interface, documentation of which actions can be run in natural language, independent or hands-on corroboration.
